newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African wool prices mixed at latest auction.
newsitem.headline: S.African wool prices mixed at latest auction.

text.p: South African wool prices were mixed at the latest weekly auction, the Wool Board said.
It said 11,375 bales were offered at this week's sale, of which 98.9 percent was sold.

Price quotes for long Merino fleeces of 20 micron fell 0.2 percent, 21 micron rose 1.3 percent, 22 micron rose 1.3 percent, 23 micron rose 0.1 percent, 24 micron rose 0.6 percent and 25 micron remain unchanged.
Prices for Merino bellies fell 0.3 percent, Merino lambs fell 2.4 percent and Merino locks rose 1.4 percent.
The offering included 2,338 bales of other White Wools, 161 bales of Ciskei/Transkei, 277 bales of Lesotho and 243 bales of coarse and coloured.
Of the 442 bales of 20 micron offered, 97.7 percent was sold. Of the 1,191 bales of 21 micron offered, 98.9 percent was sold.
Of 1,876 bales of 22 micron offered, 98.9 percent was sold, Of 1,375 bales of 23 micron offered, 99.7 percent was sold. All 24 and 25 micron bales on offer were sold.
The next sale will take place on 27 November, when 10,000 bales will be on offer.
